articles.title: A 99-Year-Old Grandma Walked to Make Freedom Day a Real Holiday!
articles.summary: Opal Lee, 99, walked miles to get Juneteenth made a national holiday. It celebrates the day in 1865 when the last enslaved people in Texas learned they were free. Now it's a day for cookouts and joy.

articles.title: Rivian's Boss Spills the Beans: Buttons Rule, Cybertruck Flops, and a Secret Plan!
articles.summary: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe talked about why the Cybertruck didn't sell big, why car buttons are awesome, and what happens if their new R2 SUV fails. Spoiler: they spent billions getting ready!

articles.title: Sam Short Splashed to Four Golds — and a World Record!
articles.summary: Aussie swimmer Sam Short won the 200, 400, 800, and 1500 freestyle at the Australian Trials. He set a world record in the 800 free. No Aussie man had done that since 2005!
